scheme_name: Assistance to General Farmers for Sinking Tubewell
other_conditions: Applicant must obtain a permit to sink a new or replacement tubewell/filter point from the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority.

Tubewell/filter point must be constructed using a departmental power rig/hand bore set or, if using private machinery, the applicant must have a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Agriculture Department for machinery registered with the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority under departmental supervision.
Applicant must hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land within the command area of the tubewell/filter point.
Applicant must have owned the land for at least two years and possess a clear ownership title deed in his/her name.
The 1.5‑acre landholding must belong to the applicant farmer, the spouse, or a member of the joint/undivided family.
Farmers who have received the same subsidy within the past five years are ineligible.
Casing pipes must have a BIS certificate and be purchased from an authorized dealer (M/s PASIC Ltd).
Applicant must not convert the land for any non‑agricultural purpose for a minimum of ten years from the date of construction and must execute a bond to this effect.
benefits_summary: 65% subsidy on tubewell/filter point construction up to ₹1,50,000 per tubewell/filter point.
documents_required: Permit from Pondicherry Ground Water Authority
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Agriculture Department (if using private machinery)
